text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Haaah...!! Hah, haaah, ...haaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft takes first place!! It's Rhein 
Kraft--!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Brilliantly overcoming a field of fierce 
rivals! The one crowned Queen of the 
Cherry Blossoms is Rheingraft! Hanshin 
Racecourse is shaking with congratulatory 
cheers!
(WOOOOOOOOOOO!!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Incredible... cheers.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(My ears are tingling. And my feet... feel 
light and floaty...)
And then, Rhein Kraft—

She returned looking light-headed and 
wobbly, her steps utterly unsteady, as if 
walking in a dream.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Trainer... san—

"Still, I understand how you feel. Though 
it has only been a little over a year, we 
have spent enough time together for me to 
know."

How deeply she had yearned for it. How 
strongly, intensely, and straightforwardly 
she had wished for it.
Because I understand, I tell her slowly.
choice_data_list:
Congratulations... You were the one in 1st 
place.

Congratulations... You're the one who took 
1st place.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: F-First place...
choice_data_list: The Oka Sho Umamusume is you.
The Oka Sho Umamusume is you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: The Oka Sho... Me...?
choice_data_list: You're the one who won the first Tiara!
You're the one who won the first Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: The Tiara...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: N-No…… I, the Tiara, ……n-n-no, aah……!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
No waaaaaay...!! I-I actually did 
ittttt...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Trai-Trainer, aaaaahhh~~~?!

As she began to wail, her arms drifted up 
and started wandering through the air. 
Wondering what to do, I gently supported 
them, and then—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Waaaahhhhh...!!

"...She pulls me into an embrace with 
incredible force. Laughing softly at her 
helplessness, I gently pat her on the 
back."

The shoulder of my suit seems to have been 
soaked in no time at all by her tears and 
such, but that's quite alright.

"However, right now... Even through our 
tears, let us raise the first Tiara we so 
desperately longed for together..."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "...Did I let it... slip away? ...Did I?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...No. The Yushun Himba (Oaks)... Next 
time, for sure—!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: It didn't... reach...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ngh... I am terribly sorry, Mother...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Next time. Next time... for sure...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: “—Yes. That's right.”

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: If that is what your heart tells you.
...And then, a few days later.

A press conference was held, bringing 
together the four racers—including Rhein 
Kraft—who had fought a fierce battle and 
captured everyone's attention in the Oka 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
“—I see! So both Cesario-san and Air 
Messiah-san will continue on the Triple 
Tiara route as planned, then.”

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes. My next race is the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
To become the cornerstone of the Tiara's 
enduring history—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The throne of the "Queen of the Oaks" will 
be mine. ...Without fail!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...I believe I am well aware of 
Cesario-san's prowess in medium-distance 
races."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"However, I have no intention of backing 
down either. So as not to disgrace my 
mother's name—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No. ...I will bring results worthy of 
elevating my mother's name even higher. I 
swear it.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!! Next up, Line 
Kraft-san—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes!! I am—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm going to set my sights on the NHK 
Mile Cup!"

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: (Oooohhh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
"'I heard the rumors, but... are they 
serious?!' 'A girl from the Tiara route, 
no way...' 'This is massive news!!'"

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
"And Rine Kraft is the Oka Sho winner...!" 
"If she wins the NHK Mile Cup as well...!" 
"She will achieve history's first 
Non-Standard Double Crown!!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...The 'NHK Mile Cup' is the only mile GⅠ 
race where the sole requirement is to be a 
Classic-tier Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whether they aim for the Triple Crown 
road, the Triple Tiara road, or the Sprint 
and Mile circuits—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's a race where all the speed-proud 
Umamusume who will shape the next era 
gather together to decide who's the 
fastest!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I will take 1st place there. I swear I 
will, no matter what!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
And—I will show all the Umamusume who set 
out on the Tiara path from now on!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'll show them my back as someone to look 
up to— proving that such possibilities and 
such futures really exist!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...!! I think that's a wonderful 
challenge to take on!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
And lastly, Daring Heart-san! Could you 
share your thoughts on your next race?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Just as she declared that she would 
'become the future Queen,' is she heading 
for the Yushun Himba (Oaks)—?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: My next race will be...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —The NHK Mile Cup.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur, murmur...!?)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh, ...wha!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Heart-san is entering the NHK Mile Cup 
too...!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Nice to meet you, Rhein Kraft.
